statement: Because xpad requires a real vendor-specific USB interface and interrupt endpoints, an xpad-faithful virtual wireless receiver requires modeled USB presentation via a custom gadget connected through dummy_hcd or an equivalent emulated USB device over USB/IP. Plain uinput may emulate evdev, and UHID may emulate generic HID, but neither binds xpad's receiver interface. No USB gadget has been built or run.
